license: The Hugging Face dataset card for allenai/qasper and its loader script state CC BY 4.0. The README inside qasper-train-dev-v0.3.tgz does not repeat the license line.
calibration_use: Held out. Not scored. Not used to choose the abstention threshold. The reported run leaves the threshold unset.
selection: Sort by paper id and question id. Shuffle answerable and unanswerable lists with random.Random(seed). Take a stratified quota that rounds evaluation_size times the dev unanswerable rate. Calibration is the next disjoint slice of each list.
reference_answer: First annotator, per the order in the v0.3 JSON. Token F1 also reports the maximum over all annotators.
preprocessing: Abstract, full-text paragraphs, and figure/table captions are kept. Figure images are not downloaded. Chunks are 200 whitespace-separated words with overlap 40, split per section by the existing chunker. The indexed collection is only the papers that appear in the evaluation questions.
test_split: The official test split is not in qasper-train-dev-v0.3.tgz and is not scored.
